---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
    shortened_season = yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
    shortened_season = factor(
      shortened_season,
      levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
      labels = c("Shortened season", "Regular season")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = shortened_season), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Shortened season" = "firebrick", "Regular season" = "steelblue"),
    name = "Season type"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Home runs per game by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database. Shortened seasons are highlighted in red."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Season comparison

```{r}
#| message: false
comparison <- Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games) |>
  arrange(factor(yearID, levels = c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020))) |>
  rename(season = yearID) |>
  mutate(home_runs_per_game = round(home_runs_per_game, 2))

comparison
```

This page will explore home runs in Major League Baseball.
